recommendation: Choose Buildkite when hybrid CI/CD (self-hosted + hosted agents) is the job — not GitHub the SCM by default, even though both sit in source-control-devops. Compare CircleCI for specialist hosted CI credits; GitHub or GitLab when you need repos plus CI in one licence; Azure DevOps for that ecosystem.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal.
